heads.t: APEC領袖化身帶貨王！澳總理逛超市嗑和牛 智利總統推櫻桃 亞太經濟合作會議（APEC）峰會於近日（18）在中國深圳登場，各國領袖陸續抵達後，除了參與外交活動，也紛紛走入當地商圈，掀起另類城市外交熱潮。澳洲總理艾班尼斯親自走訪超市，了解澳洲農產品在中國市場的銷售情況；智利總統卡斯特則現身水果店，俄羅斯總統普亭也公開稱讚深圳的城市建設與創新實力。 11 分鐘前｜國際 APEC領袖化身帶貨王！澳總理逛超市嗑和牛 智利總統推櫻桃 11 分鐘前｜國際
heads.en: The APEC leader is the king of goods! The Australian Prime Minister, who straddled the supermarkets and oxen, and the Chilean President, who pushed the cherries, the APEC summit, recently arrived in Shenzhen, China (18), and the leaders of all the countries who have come to China to take part in diplomatic activities have also walked into the local business circle and set in motion other urban diplomacy. Prime Minister Abernathy visited the supermarket personally to learn about the sale of Australian agricultural products in the Chinese market; Chilean President Caster came to the fruit shop, and Russian President Putin publicly praised Shenzhen for building and innovative cities. 11 minutes ago, the world's APEC leader turned into a cargo king!
